conditional_gravity_closure.evidence: Revised518-leaf inventory plus thor-moving-mass-evidence.json and source-backed intended phase arrangement. Explicit assumptions close only this conditional gravity model; full physical wrist demands remain unknown.
assumptions: Whole manufacturer motor masses remain allocated once per complete installed asset: seven motors total2.120kg; no guessed internal rotor/stator mass split.
Each undecomposed motor internal rotor is centered and statically balanced about its shaft, so internal rotation leaves total motor COM fixed. Actual rotor eccentricity/mass is unmeasured.
Both added belts use explicit unmeasured1200kg/m3 mass scenarios and uniform circulating material on a fixed closed Art4 path, hence fixed spatial COM under q5/q6.
Input pulleys and grub screws rotate about their actual native motor axes at twice their corresponding side-pulley angle under ideal uncrossed no-slip belts.
Ideal15/30 bevel kinematics use intended s=+1 as chosen arrangement; opposite phase is sensitivity only. Saved CAD overlap/apex/module mismatch prevents conjugate-mesh validation.
Compound bearing centroids follow declared support geometry; race/cage inertia/contact is not modeled. Printed and purchased solid centroids remain unmeasured uniform-volume COM proxies.
Gripper leaves retain their saved jaw pose; their mass is included. Jaw opening is a separate coordinate study, not missing installed mass.
Gravity only with no friction, acceleration, belt tension redistribution, omitted wiring, manufacturing errors, collision or physical limits qualification.

chosen_intended_phase.evidence: docs/thor-wrist-handedness.md and hardware/cad/thor-wrist-handedness.json; intended no-slip 15/30 arrangement with common native +Y side axes. Saved CAD gears overlap and are not established conjugate meshes.

inventory_coverage_revision.correction: Two installed App::Link-group wrist belts added; four existing Art4 input-pulley/grub-screw leaves now spin about their own motor shaft axes.
